d: Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates a portfolio of 29 exceptional properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, Asia, and Africa. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and since then the brand has become known for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels, and exclusive branded residences. Jumeirah is synonymous with Arabian luxury hospitality and the ability to craft distinctive, purposeful experiences for the world’s most discerning travellers.

Located on the pristine beaches of Bahrain’s West Coast, the resort features stunning ocean views, verdant greenery, and meandering waterways with modern, spacious rooms and suites as well as an exclusive Gulf Summer House, located directly on the beach. Guests can enjoy a variety of water sports activities, the resort’s five pools, and book treatments at Jumeirah’s signature Talise Spa.
q: The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
At least 3 to 4 years Bartending/Mixologist experience (preferably within the international hospitality industry).
Proven experience as a Mixologist, Senior Bartender, or similar role, preferably in a luxury hotel, resort, restaurant, or high-end bar.
Strong knowledge of spirits, liqueurs, wines, bitters, syrups, fresh ingredients, and cocktail techniques.
Demonstrated experience in cocktail menu creation and beverage program development.
Good understanding of beverage costing, inventory management, and stock control.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
Relevant bartending/mixology certification is an advantage.
r: p
An opportunity has arisen for a Head Mixologist to join our Food and Beverage Team in Jumeirah Gulf of Bahrain. The main duties and responsibilities of this role:
li
Identify and meet guests’ needs, provide appropriate bar services, and assist guests in recommendations, upselling where appropriate to provide knowledgeable and bespoke service
li
Lead and supervise bartenders and bar staff during daily operations.
li
Create, develop, and maintain innovative cocktail and beverage menus.
li
Establish and maintain recipes, specifications, garnishes, and presentation standards.
li
Ensure consistency and quality of all cocktails and beverages.
li
Train and coach bartenders on mixology, service standards, product knowledge, and responsible alcohol service.
li
Monitor beverage inventory, stock levels, wastage, and product quality.
li
Assist with purchasing and maintain good relationships with suppliers.
x: We offer an attractive tax-free salary, paid in Bahraini Dinar (BHD), the local currency of Bahrain. In addition, we offer reduced hotel rates across our properties globally, excellent leave and health care package, flights home, accommodation, life insurance, 50% discount off Jumeirah F&B Outlets and reduced hotel rates.

d: The Head of Finance role within a fast-growing securities entity requires expertise in accounting, finance and treasury to lead financial operations and strategy. This position involves overseeing financial planning, consolidation, reporting, and regulatory compliance to support the group's business growth. This role reports to the local CEO and the Group CFO.
q: At least 10 years solid experience in audit and securities firms and knowledge in financial industry products
Degree Holder in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
Professional accounting qualifications such as CPA, ACCA, or an equivalent certification.
Strong knowledge of accounting and reporting standards
In-depth knowledge and experience in handling local capital adequacy rules is a MUST.
Proven leadership and team management capabilities, with the ability to mentor and develop high-performing teams.
Strong sense of business acumen, analytical, communication and reporting skills;
Mature, agile and demonstrate a positive mindset
Proficiency in computer literacy, ERP platforms, open-minded mindset in embracing AI, new-gen accounting and control system
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Good command in both spoken & written English is a MUST. Mandarin speaking is an advantage.

li

li

li

li
System development, devise user requirement, UAT for systems
li
Collaborating with other departments to align financial goals with business objectives.

d: A construction company is seeking an experienced Projects Manager to lead the delivery of tower and high-rise building projects in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
Manage projects from initial planning through completion and handover.
Oversee site execution to ensure compliance with drawings, specifications, and contract requirements.
Monitor project schedules, budgets, and performance indicators.
Coordinate with consultants, contractors, suppliers, and relevant authorities.
Ensure compliance with quality, health, safety, and environmental standards.
Identify project risks, resolve challenges, and provide regular progress reports.
A minimum of 10 years of hands-on experience in the execution and management of tower and high-rise building projects.
A bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related field.
Strong leadership, communication, and team-management skills.
Proven ability to manage project costs, schedules, and resources.
Experience with project management and planning software is preferred.
To monitor, on a shift basis, the FG lounge operation in Bahrain and to ensure exceptional standards of customer services to all VVIP, VIP, and CIP customers traveling on Gulf Air.
q: Good command of English language both written & spoken, equivalent to Ordinary National Diploma level.
Computer literacy - SSCI and Falcon System.
If you meet the criteria and you are enthusiastic about the role, we would welcome your application. To complete the application you would need the following document(s):
Ensure all passengers are welcomed and assisted throughout their stay at the Lounge and are accorded the highest levels of customer service continuously.
Maintain the daily passenger movement through the HUB - ensuring all passengers have boarded their flight in a timely manner thereby maintaining Gulf Air’s OTP standards.

Ensure the smooth running of the Lounge with respect to Catering, Cleaning and Maintenance. Ensure the shift check-list is adhered to and any discrepancies are detailed in the shift report and highlighted to the relevant concerned immediately towards resolving the shortfalls. Follow up continuously until the shortfall is resolved.
Brief staff of their duties, ensure the walk-around is conducted regularly towards monitoring Lounge catering and cleaning standards and maintaining the timely departure of all customers.
Maintain an excellent rapport with the shift Airport Duty Manager and Hub Control towards ensuring a smooth and professional operation in the Lounge.
Assist the Lounge Manager in maintaining accurate data entry by conducting spot reviews of the data entered in the Lounge passenger system on a weekly basis.
Assist the Lounge Manager in the follow up of complaints/ reports and take appropriate action to maintain acceptable service standards.
Maintain stock control of all Product items and Service items and ensure that the items required for daily operations are available all times.
Proactively and transparently, report all discrepancies noted in the handling of the customer contrary to Gulf Air’s standards and ensure a follow through wherever necessary.
Ensure that staff on your shift are well groomed; report any grooming discrepancies that affect Gulf Air’s standards.
Responsibly monitor the operation of the shift, ensuring that all Last minute Airport Upgrades by payment or redemption are transacted with accuracy and as per company policy.
Ensure that all Lounge financial transactions are recorded accurately and a rapport is maintained effectively with the Finance Department through a daily Finance shift report in this regard.
Liaise and communicate closely with Catering teams, Cargo, Airport Managers, Area Managers and Public Relations Officers of each station in relation to onboard VIP’s.
Assist the Lounge Manager in replying, follow up, and implementing improvement strategies in relation to Cabin Crew Reports, Customer Relations Department, and any passenger complaints received.

Assist the Lounge Manager in establishing a professional working relationship in the areas of communication and public relations with all Gulf Air Traffic/Sales, Reservations Department, Handling Agent staff, CAA Authority, and other officials in order to ensure smooth handling of all passengers.
Be a good role model in the way you are groomed and the manner in which you conduct yourself. Ensure the company business is handled as expected from you.
